concept.title_pre: A festival where everyone can finally
concept.intro: FLORE is the first 100% gluten-free and lactose-free festival. Concerts, DJ sets, food court, bar and shop: everything we love about a festival, without the usual sacrifices. A full day to dance, taste and enjoy, no second-guessing.

cards.title: 100% gluten‑free
cards.text: The Jardin des Saveurs food court and our bars are guaranteed gluten-free (below 20 ppm, the strictest standard). Safe even for coeliacs.

cards.title: 100% lactose‑free
cards.text: The Jardin des Saveurs food court and our bars are entirely lactose-free, so you can enjoy without a second thought.

cards.title: Music & food court
cards.text: Live concerts, DJ sets, food trucks and a bar. The full festival vibe, no compromise.

manifesto.quote: FLORE isn't a festival for people on a diet. It's a festival, full stop, that happens to be 100% gluten-free and lactose-free, so no one ever has to choose between having fun and eating with peace of mind.

geo.text: FLORE takes place at Ainterexpo, in Bourg-en-Bresse: a region built for travellers from all directions, an easy reach from Switzerland, northern Italy and southern Germany, as well as the rest of France.

chips.label: Northern Italy, a few hours away

visit.text: Ainterexpo is easy to reach by car, train or plane, about 50 minutes from Lyon and 1h15 from Geneva. Full details on getting there (in French) are on flore-festival.fr/infos-pratiques/.

items.a: FLORE is a one-day music and food festival, entirely gluten-free and lactose-free: concerts, DJ sets, a food court, a shop and wellbeing spaces, all on one site, all safe to eat and drink without a second thought.

items.q: Is it only for people with allergies or intolerances?
items.a: Not at all. FLORE is a festival for everyone, that happens to be 100% gluten-free and lactose-free. Think of it as any other festival: line-up, food, atmosphere, just without the usual dietary stress for those who need it.

items.q: When and where will it take place?
items.a: Saturday 17 April 2027, at Ainterexpo in Bourg-en-Bresse, France, between Lyon and Geneva.
Yes, tickets are on sale now on our official box office (in French), with a Day Pass and an Evening Pass (6pm to 10pm).

items.q: Is the food really safe for coeliacs?
items.a: Yes. Our food court (Jardin des Saveurs) and bars follow a strict below-20ppm gluten standard, the threshold recognised for coeliac disease, with dedicated preparation to avoid cross-contamination.

items.q: Do I need to travel far to get there?
items.a: No. Ainterexpo is about 50 minutes from Lyon and 1h15 from Geneva, easily reached by car, train or plane.

tickets.text: Tickets are on sale now on our official box office. Choose the Day Pass or the Evening Pass, whichever suits you best.
tickets.pass_day_desc: Everything: stage, food court, shop and wellbeing talks, from the first act to the last set.
tickets.pass_evening_desc: Golden hour and an evening of dancing, if you can only make it later in the day.

pro.title: A business outside France?
pro.text: Foreign brand, distributor or event partner interested in a stand or a partnership at FLORE? Write to us directly, we'll get back to you.

footer.about: The first 100% gluten-free and lactose-free festival. A MG Entertainment production, because the party should be open to everyone.
